verdict.rationale: Square's docs confirm a general REST/SDK platform (square-docs-2, square-gh-1/2) and dedicated Invoices/Subscriptions APIs, suggesting an agent could programmatically create billing objects in one session, but the evidence pack never cites a Catalog API (for products/prices) or a Payment Links/Checkout API, which are the specific pieces this story requires. Missing for 10: explicit Catalog API (item/price creation) documentation, explicit Payment Links API documentation, and a hands-on example chaining product+price+payment-link creation in one session.
